summary: You're working across some challenging subjects, and right now several competencies are sitting in the gap range, all closely bunched in the low-to-mid 40s. The good news is that the marker feedback is consistent and specific, which gives you a clear map of exactly what to revise. Let's focus on the foundational skills first, since strengthening data structures and object-oriented design will support your capstone work too. These are formative signals to guide your study, not a verdict on you.

priorities.evidence: This is your lowest attainment at 43.5%, evidenced only in CSE3CAP. Both the Final written Project Report (43.0%) and Sprint Project management reports (44.0%) flagged gaps in industry standard technical solutions in software or cybersecurity practice.
priorities.actions: Revisit the marker feedback on CSE3CAP:Assignment: Final written Project Report and identify where your solution departed from industry standards. Then re-attempt a small technical solution focused on CSE3CAP:SILO2, applying a recognised standard or best-practice pattern, and check it against published industry guidelines before submitting.

priorities.evidence: This is a persistent, stable gap at 43.9% across CSE1OOF (47.8%) and CSE2ALG (43.2%). Your CSE2ALG:Central examination (42.0%) and CSE2ALG:Assignment (42.0%) both flagged identifying, implementing and evaluating data structures and sorting/searching algorithms.
priorities.actions: Re-work the problems from CSE2ALG:Assignment, practising implementing searching and sorting algorithms in Java (CSE2ALG:SILO3) on small, well-tested examples first. Then use the CSE2ALG:Test feedback to consolidate identifying suitable data structures (CSE2ALG:SILO2) and comparing algorithm choices (CSE2ALG:SILO4) before revisiting encapsulation in CSE1OOF:SILO2.

priorities.evidence: Project Management sits at 44.0%, evidenced only in CSE3CAP. The Sprint Project management reports (44.0%) specifically flagged advanced project management during substantive development implementation.
priorities.actions: Revisit the feedback on CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports and re-draft one sprint report focused on CSE3CAP:SILO1, making planning, tracking and risk decisions explicit with evidence, and seek early feedback before the next milestone.

priorities.evidence: At 47.6% in CSE1OOF, this is your closest gap to passing. The Central examination (48.0%), Assignment (49.0%) and Practical demonstration (44.0%) all flagged object-oriented design, code reuse, and combining data and behaviour.
priorities.actions: Use the CSE1OOF:Central examination feedback to practise object-oriented design of a small real-life problem (CSE1OOF:SILO4), then refactor it to apply code sharing and reuse (CSE1OOF:SILO3). Re-attempt the CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration style tasks, explaining your design decisions to strengthen CSE1OOF:SILO1.
